evidence_first_rule: No row is PASS on the strength of an older checkpoint. Each row records accepted implementation/evidence ancestry, current production authority, a CURRENT-HEAD acceptance proof that was executed, the current result, and the historical supporting checkpoint. Old evidence is supporting history only.

rows.frozen_definition: PASS when arbitrary source bytes can be stored/retrieved exactly with verified source SHA256.
rows.known_limitations: None material. Eight awkward source classes were exercised (empty, single NUL, embedded NUL text, non-UTF8 latin-1, invalid UTF-8 sequence, all 256 byte values, high-bit pseudo-random, JSON-like binary) plus a ZSTD transparency case.

rows.frozen_definition: PASS when the crash matrix produces no cursor skip or half-valid final object.
rows.production_authority: storage.atomic.publish_no_replace with FaultPoint/RaiseFaultHook; storage.manifests.PartitionManifestRepository.append_partition_manifest with PointerFaultPoint P1..P5
rows.known_limitations: Fault injection is deterministic in-process; it cannot simulate power-loss below the filesystem level, only the code's own ordering guarantees.

rows.frozen_definition: PASS when committed T0A cannot be overwritten through public storage APIs.
rows.production_authority: storage.atomic no-replace publish; LocalBlobStore._verify_existing raising ExistingBlobIntegrityConflict
rows.known_limitations: The hardlink mutation proof is skipped on filesystems without hardlink support (Windows volumes without the privilege); it did not skip in this run.

rows.frozen_definition: PASS when the same source key with different bytes creates an explicit revision and preserves both versions.
rows.known_limitations: SourceRevisionRegistry and RevisionSourceIdentityV1 are not exported in the package __all__; downstream consumers read revision state through RawEvidenceResult.revision_state. This is recorded, not a gate failure.

rows.frozen_definition: PASS when all current manifests reference existing valid objects and historical versions remain available.
PASS when every T0B projection resolves completely to T0A blob/acquisition evidence.
PASS when no acquisition, no data, failure and history unavailable are distinguishable and NONE become numeric zero.
rows.known_limitations: A provider failure page is exercised as a typed refusal with zero mutation rather than as a persisted FAILED manifest; the FAILED coverage state exists in the vocabulary but the handoff refuses the contradictory batch instead of committing a failure record. This is fail-closed behaviour, recorded rather than hidden.

rows.frozen_definition: PASS when optional high-volume writes pause before critical P0 sensor evidence and no raw auto-deletion occurs.
rows.known_limitations: Measured against a synthetic 100 GiB capacity with a 256 MiB floor so the PRESSURE policy is exercised independently of the hard-floor policy; the hard floor is measured separately and blocks P0 as well.

rows.frozen_definition: PASS when DuckDB discovery is reconstructed from manifest/projection files on an empty catalog.
rows.known_limitations: The corrupt-durable-source case corrupts a JSON catalog fragment. A truncated binary payload with a valid catalog would be caught by the integrity layer rather than the catalog reader; that path is covered by the accepted I15 corruption matrix as supporting evidence.

rows.frozen_definition: PASS when PostgreSQL contains metadata/state only and raw payload tables are absent.
rows.known_limitations: NO LIVE POSTGRES EXECUTION WAS PERFORMED OR CLAIMED. No DSN was available in this environment (SENSOR_FABRIC_POSTGRES_DSN and DATABASE_URL are both unset). The decision rests on the current-head schema and runtime contract test plus the accepted I11 live evidence. This limitation is recorded in the artifact itself and is not papered over.

rows.frozen_definition: PASS when the fixture evidence pack restores into an empty root and hashes/query results match.
rows.known_limitations: The pack is small by construction; the accepted I13 resource-limit matrices cover the bounded-size refusal path as supporting evidence.

rows.frozen_definition: PASS when adapter output persists and the resume checkpoint advances ONLY AFTER durable manifest commit.
rows.known_limitations: Measured on a 3-page sequence over ONE partition, so the durable manifests are 3 versions of that partition (v1, v2, v3) with a single current pointer. That is the correct shape for a paginated job and is reported as versions rather than as three distinct current manifests.

rows.frozen_definition: PASS when RawNormalizationBatch exposes sufficient SOURCE, TIMESTAMP, UNIT and LINEAGE evidence for PIT normalization WITHOUT filesystem/path assumptions.
rows.blocking_reason_if_any: I16_G4_13_UNIT_HANDOFF_CONTRACT_GAP — the UNIT dimension is not publicly and deterministically reachable. RawNormalizationBatch has 20 fields and no native_unit / unit_state / provider_unit / UNIT_UNVERIFIED. crypto_sensor_fabric.storage.__all__ has 194 names and no unit-named export. No public enum member is UNIT_UNVERIFIED. ProjectionSchemaDefinition.to_descriptor() exposes exactly name/type/nullable per provider-native field. A test-only Bloc 5 consumer restricted to public storage imports reports native_unit and unit_state as NOT_REACHABLE. SOURCE, TIME and LINEAGE all pass and two distinct storage roots produce an identical public evidence view.
rows.known_limitations: This is a contract gap, not evidence corruption. No T0A/T0B record is wrong; the unit is simply not discoverable through a public typed contract. Per the frozen operator instruction the repair is NOT applied inside final acceptance.
